name: Camunda BPMN for ECA
description: BPMN modeller for ECA, standalone desktop application with import and export from and to this Drupal site.
project_description: Camunda BPMN for ECA registers a single ECA Modeller plugin so ECA models can be authored as BPMN 2.0 diagrams in the standalone Camunda Modeler desktop application and imported into / exported from the Drupal site. It is a thin subclass of eca_modeller_bpmn's ModellerBpmnBase, contributing only the 'bpmn:' XML namespace prefix and a template-export override; all real modelling logic lives in the ECA base module. The project is marked Unsupported/Obsolete on drupal.org (deprecated in favour of ECA's built-in modellers).
